scenarios.scenario_note: Two probes. 'songs with exactly three clarinets' is hyper-specific with nothing enforceable: expected accuracy=impossible, with asks carrying the next step (never a dead end). 'instrumentals with heavy lead vocals over 300 bpm' is a mixed impossible ask whose vocals half intent-v1 cannot yet express as a claim; asserted only that the answer stays honest — accuracy in [partial, impossible, contradictory] (never specific) — and that the library resolve underfills instead of faking results.
